title: The Simple task for the boy
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：simple　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 simple 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the keeper wrote of ① a simple task for the boy in the register, and everybody in the zoo said at once that it was ② simpler than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the simple ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the simplest task for the boy anybody in the zoo had ever seen, or so the register for March 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too simple to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the simple ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a simple life of the family, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as simple as the life of the family they had once had in the old zoo. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was simple or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something simple, and nothing besides. The child from the next zoo called the whole plan ⑧ quite simple; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the simple ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, in public, she wrote of another simple task for the boy in the same register, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ simpler than anybody had expected. ⑩ The simplest life of the family in the whole zoo, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the simple ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 简单（前置定语 a simple task for the boy：1952 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的那件简单的活计）
B. adj. 简单／朴素（比较级 simpler than：文中两处，一处比交给男孩的简单活计，一处比预想）
C. adj. 简单／朴素（最高级 the simplest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 简单（表语 too simple to do：母亲觉得它太简单，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 朴素（前置定语 a simple life of the family：叔叔把整件事称作一桩朴素的生活）
F. adj. 朴素（同级比较 as simple as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩一家朴素的生活相比）
G. adj. 朴素（后置定语 something simple：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 朴素（受程度副词修饰 quite simple：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a simple task for the boy
the simplest task for the boy anybody
a simple life of the family
The simplest life of the family in

answers.why: simple 意为“简单”，1952 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的是“一件简单的活计”，此处作前置定语 a simple task for the boy。
simple 意为“简单”，此处用比较级 simpler than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
simple 意为“简单”，饲养台账上 三月 那行字说它是兽舍里最简单的一件，故用最高级 the simplest task for the boy。
simple 意为“简单”，母亲认为这件东西“太简单了，谁也用不上”，too simple to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
simple 意为“朴素”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩朴素的生活”，此处作前置定语 a simple life of the family。
simple 意为“朴素”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩一家朴素的生活一样朴素”，同级比较用 as simple as。
simple 意为“朴素”，饲养台账上那半行字要的是“朴素的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something simple。
simple 意为“朴素”，邻兽舍来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当朴素”，quite 修饰原级 simple。
simple 意为“朴素”，1962 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要朴素”，故用比较级 simpler than。
simple 意为“朴素”，母亲 1964 年说的是“整个兽舍里最朴素的那一桩”，故用最高级 the simplest life of the family。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，饲养员在饲养台账里记下了一件简单的活计。（a simple task for the boy）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更简单。（simpler than …）
母亲觉得它太简单，谁也用不上。（too simple to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩朴素的生活。（a simple life of the family）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩一家朴素的生活一样朴素。（as simple as …）
到了 1959 年，饲养台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件朴素的东西。（something simple）
answers: In 1952 the keeper wrote of a simple task for the boy in the register.
Everybody said it was simpler than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too simple to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a simple life of the family.
He said nobody would call it as simple as the life of the family they had once had.
By 1959 the register asked for nothing but something simple.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 simple 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the keeper wrote of a simple task for the boy in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the simplest task for the boy in the zoo, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too simple to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a simple life of the family, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next zoo called the plan quite simple, and everybody laughed.
The simple ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
